capabilities: Generate deterministic terrain and settlement maps from a seed
Tune maps in a live side-panel preview
Embed reproducible maps via town-forge code blocks
Read map settings from note properties or a linked note
Export interactive pinned maps with per-place notes to TTRPG Tools: Maps
disambiguation: Despite the name, it also generates terrain-only landscape maps, not just settlements.
extras: Still in beta; recommended install is via BRAT. Extra setup docs live in docs/randomness-templater-setup.md. Map icons only render if the corresponding keys exist in the maps plugin's icon library.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate reproducible fantasy landscape and settlement maps for game preparation.

relations.evidence: Town Forge can hand a finished map to the TTRPG Tools: Maps community plugin (formerly Zoom Map)
Randomness — drives rich, correlated place names and note bodies from your templates.
Any Randomness or Templater syntax in the template is left intact

summary: Procedural fantasy map generator for tabletop RPGs, building seeded terrain and settlement maps as code blocks, PNGs, or pinned interactive maps.
